s1.p2: Abbreviation for **Not a Number** (the result of an operation is not a number)
s1.p3: Can result from type casting, for example:
s1.p4: ⟦f1⟧ is a property of the global object (⟦f2⟧)
s1.p5: ⟦f1⟧ is also a property of the built-in object ⟦f3⟧
s1.p6: ![ico-20 warn] ⟦f1⟧ is not equal to anything, not even itself
s1.p7: To determine whether ⟦f1⟧ is the value of an expression,
s1.p8: you can use the methods  ⟦f4⟧  and  ⟦f5⟧
s1.p10: ^^⟦f4⟧  returns ⟦f6⟧ if, after casting the argument to a number, the result is  ⟦f1⟧^^
s1.p11: ^^⟦f5⟧ returns ⟦f6⟧ if the argument has the value ⟦f1⟧ (no type casting occurs)^^
s2.p3: ![ico-20 warn] ⟦f8⟧ can only be equal to ⟦f8⟧ or (in a non-strict comparison) ⟦f9⟧
s3.p2: A value exceeding the maximum possible floating-point number
s3.p5: ⟦f11⟧ may be the result of dividing a non-zero number by zero
